What they did
The commenter says they use Muse to book hotels, hunt for deals, and compare rooms within a resort so they do not have to do that research themselves. In this thread, they do not explain the workflow, what sites or accounts Muse used, or where they personally stepped in.
How it went
They report that it saves them the manual research, but they give no prices, savings, booking count, or examples of a completed stay. The source does not describe any limitations beyond the lack of detail.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Find and book a hotel in [city] from [check-in date] to [check-out date] for [number] guests, with a budget of [amount] per night and these preferences: [location, amenities, cancellation policy]. Show me your top three options with prices and cancellation terms. Pause and get my approval before entering payment details or confirming any booking.
